name: CUTE SLIDING BEAR CAR DASHBOARD TOY
description:
✅ Sliding Motion

Cute bear slides as your car moves – fun and eye-catching!

✅ Adorable Design

Skateboarding bear adds personality to your dashboard.

✅ Parking Number Display

Flip-style card shows your contact info when parked.

✅ Durable Material

Built with high-quality, long-lasting plastic/resin.

✅ Easy to Install

Strong adhesive – just peel and stick, no tools needed.

✅ Compact Size

Fits any dashboard without blocking your view.
